title: Power Stack Daily Research Refresh
regime: Capital scarcity re-accelerates as strong September US activity pushes the Treasury curve back above 5%, while AI funding remains open but increasingly debt-heavy and selective.
whatIsNewNow: September US flash Composite PMI rose to 58.4 from 56.0, the strongest since July 2021; supply delays and backlogs also lifted price pressure.
US 10Y reached about 5.10% and 10Y real TIPS yield about 2.78%, both major valuation hurdles; weak 5Y auction demand adds term-premium/issuance risk.
SoftBank completed $11.1B of dollar/euro bonds to fund its OpenAI investment. AI funding is not shut, but leverage and credit-market dependence are becoming first-order filters.
US-China trade truce was extended by two months ahead of the Trump-Xi summit; AI and rare-earth/critical-mineral access remain central strategic issues.
Oil rebounded after five losing sessions, but US diesel futures fell to a two-week low amid export-policy headlines. Crude and refined-product signals are diverging again.
AI cybersecurity showed relative strength in a broad risk-off session; PANW and CRWD rose about 5% while all S&P sectors except energy fell.
Accelevation (ACCV) enters differentiated research: power distribution, cooling and modular data-centre infrastructure, but IPO pricing/valuation and post-listing execution must clear the entry bar.
